title: Geometrically normal tensor normal domains
statement: Let k be a field and A,B commutative k-algebras which are normal domains. If A is geometrically normal over k, then A tensor_k B is a normal ring.

source.place: Tag 06DF, reduction to normal domains and finite-type tensor argument

proof.text: Use finite-type normal subalgebra extensions and the filtered tensor-product colimit to reduce B to finite type. The fraction field of A is separable by geometric reducedness; express it as a filtered colimit of smooth subalgebras. Smooth base change over the normal domain B is normal, and localization identifies the stages. The finite-type case then follows from the total-fraction-ring intersection argument and the reduced normal characterization.
